family_reports.body: I can’t put into words the way I feel or what it’s done. I’m a completely different person who feels like I can’t even be myself because it’ll be used against me, so I try to stay quiet and hold back even joking with family and friends.
The family courts have contributed greatly to my son's emotional distress over time. It has drained me financially of the ability to save for my son's educational future.

This system has annihilated my confidence in our justice system. It has left my child and myself homeless and penniless and they did not care. The worst part is seeing how many more victims they have made as well as myself. Jason Price was the husband that i loved, but he assaulted me, betrayed me and lied repeatedly and these corrupt actors protected him. Law enforcement also lied — the Ovilla PD literally wrote falsehoods in the police report. I have physical injuries as well that have never been treated and are a constant source of excruciating pain.
